# spo_restricted_search (Resource)

Manages tenant restricted search (mode + allowed site list; Set/Get-SPORestrictedSearchMode + Add/Remove-SPORestrictedSearchAllowedList, CSOM). Singleton. Requires a SharePoint Premium license.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires a SharePoint Premium license.
resource "spo_restricted_search" "this" {
  mode         = "Enabled"
  allowed_list = ["https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/marketing"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Restricted search mode: Disabled or Enabled.

### Optional

- `allowed_list` (Set of String) Site URLs allowed in search when restricted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `identity` (String) Identity used to target the object in cmdlets.
